Art Academy - Lessons for Everyone!.name: Art Academy: Lessons for Everyone!
Art Academy - Lessons for Everyone!.summary: Art Academy: Lessons for Everyone! is an interactive application that teaches real world art techniques anyone can enjoy-from beginners to experts of all ages. Discover more than 30 lessons, all using realistic stylus and touch screen-based tools for drawing and painting. Enjoy a robust Free Paint mode that lets you create to your heart's content using included subjects, or your own images taken with the Nintendo 3DS Camera—whenever and wherever the inspiration strikes.

Bikkuriman Kanjuku Haou - Sanmi Douran S.name: Bikkuriman Kanjuku Haou Sanmi Douran Sensouki
Bikkuriman Kanjuku Haou - Sanmi Douran S.summary: Kanji learning game from Nippon Ichi Software featuring many of its characters. One of the first titles being released on 3DS in the summer of 2011.

Hello Kitty and the Apron of Magic - Rhy.name: Hello Kitty and the Apron of Magic: Rhythm Cooking
Hello Kitty and the Apron of Magic - Rhy.summary: Join Hello Kitty and her friends in the kitchen for this fun-packed cooking caper, jammed with mini-games that see you baking to the beat.

Shin Megami Tensei IV - Final.name: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse
Shin Megami Tensei IV - Final.summary: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse is a post-apocalyptic role-playing video game developed and published by Atlus for the Nintendo 3DS. It is set in the same universe as Shin Megami Tensei IV and forms part of the Shin Megami Tensei series, the central series of the Megami Tensei franchise.
